summary: Order email-thread members from exact hashed local relationships and mark cyclic parent/reference graphs ambiguous without dropping messages.
decision_refs: Active user goal to continue improving accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and email content
Existing requirement that email relationships remain exact and non-inferential
approval_evidence: The active user goal explicitly includes continued email accuracy and adaptability improvements.
known_limitations: Ordering uses exact locally available hashed Message-ID relationships only; external ancestors cannot be placed in the local member list.
Sibling messages use deterministic filename/document-ID order rather than an inferred chronological order.
Validation is synthetic and offline; no mailbox, model or external provider request is used.
